prepare_diagnostic.py.text:
"""Prepare one same-host reference diagnostic from immutable source bytes only."""
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import hashlib, json, os, stat, sys, zipfile

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/dda74a4fae35')
OUT = ROOT / 'v83-cold-path-audit-r1/diagnostic-r1'
OUT.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
ARCHIVE = ROOT / 'v80-65ce-core-terminal-r1/ORIGINAL-ARTIFACT.zip'
NEW = ROOT / 'v83-native-receipt-union-r1/source'
FINAL = ROOT / 'v83-native-receipt-union-r1/FINAL-SOURCE-MANIFEST.json'

def ident(raw):
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()}

def write(name, obj):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')

def tree_hash(manifest):
    top = {}
    for name, meta in manifest.items():
        node = top
        parts = name.split('/')
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            node = node.setdefault(part, {})
        node[parts[-1]] = (meta['mode'], meta['blob'])
    def build(node):
        raw = b''
        for name, obj in sorted(node.items(), key=lambda item: (item[0] + ('/' if isinstance(item[1], dict) else '')).encode()):
            mode, sha = ('40000', build(obj)) if isinstance(obj, dict) else obj
            raw += mode.encode() + b' ' + name.encode() + b'\0' + bytes.fromhex(sha)
        return hashlib.sha1(b'tree ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()
    return build(top)

final_raw = FINAL.read_bytes()
assert len(final_raw) == 815692
assert hashlib.sha256(final_raw).hexdigest() == '129db14408a555a7ff72f64fc45d4145eeda2e9884d42fb426541c259a0f0f3a'
new_manifest = json.loads(final_raw)
assert len(new_manifest) == 3324
for name, expected in new_manifest.items():
    path = NEW / name
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), name
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert ident(raw) == {k: expected[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256', 'blob')}, name
    assert stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == int(expected['mode'], 8) & 0o777, name
new_tree = tree_hash(new_manifest)
assert new_tree.startswith('bc276'), new_tree
(OUT / 'B-source-manifest.json').write_bytes(final_raw)

old = OUT / '65ce-cold-source'
old.mkdir(mode=0o700)
old_manifest = {}
with zipfile.ZipFile(ARCHIVE) as z:
    cold_raw = z.read('hia-cold.json')
    cold = json.loads(cold_raw)
    source_hashes = cold['source_manifest']
    for name, expected_sha in source_hashes.items():
        parts = PurePosixPath(name).parts
        assert parts and '..' not in parts and not name.startswith('/')
        info = z.getinfo('hia-cold.cold/source/' + name)
        raw = z.read(info)
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected_sha, name
        mode = stat.S_IMODE(info.external_attr >> 16)
        assert mode == 0o400, (name, mode)
        path = old / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        path.chmod(mode)
        assert path.read_bytes() == raw and stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) == mode
        old_manifest[name] = {**ident(raw), 'mode': format(stat.S_IFREG | mode, 'o')}
    (OUT / '65ce-original-cold.json').write_bytes(cold_raw)
assert len(old_manifest) == 1071
write('A-source-manifest.json', old_manifest)
same = []
for name in ('tools/hia_selfhost_references.py', 'tools/hia_selfhost_signed_cases.py',
             'tools/hia_selfhost_scalar_casts.py', 'tools/hia_selfhost_process_owner.py',
             'examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost.hiaasm'):
    a = (old / name).read_bytes()
    b = (NEW / name).read_bytes()
    assert a == b, name
    same.append({'path': name, **ident(a)})
write('INPUT-IDENTITY.json', {
    'schema': 'hia.cold-reference-same-host-input.v1',
    'scope': 'DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; ordinary Core VM references; not native/cold/full qualification',
    'python': sys.executable, 'python_version': sys.version,
    'allowed_cpus': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), 'cpu': min(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
    'A': {'source': str(old), 'files': 1071, 'kind': 'exact original 65ce cold source export; no Git checkout'},
    'B': {'source': str(NEW), 'files': 3324, 'tree': new_tree,
          'final_manifest': str(FINAL), 'final_manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(final_raw).hexdigest()},
    'same_worker_case_and_supervisor_bytes': same,
    'order': ['signed:A', 'signed:B', 'signed:B', 'signed:A',
              'scalar-casts:A', 'scalar-casts:B', 'scalar-casts:B', 'scalar-casts:A'],
    'outer_seconds': 180, 'cleanup_seconds': 3,
    'original_worker_and_bodies_changed': False,
    'comparison': 'complete original canonical reference payload bytes and original reference_sha256; full envelopes retained',
})
print(json.dumps({'prepared': True, 'A_files': 1071, 'B_files': 3324,
                  'B_tree': new_tree, 'python': sys.executable, 'cpu': min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))}))

"""Run exactly eight unchanged reference workers, under the original owner."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, stat, subprocess, sys, time, traceback

OUT = Path('/workspace/scratch/dda74a4fae35/v83-cold-path-audit-r1/diagnostic-r1')

def wire(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()

def write(path, obj):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')

def guard(source, manifest):
    observed = {}
    for name, expected in manifest.items():
        path = source / name
        assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), name
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        row = {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
               'blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest(),
               'mode': format(stat.S_IFREG | stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode), 'o')}
        assert row == expected, name
        observed[name] = row
    return {'files': len(observed), 'manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(wire(observed)).hexdigest()}

def child():
    config = json.loads((OUT / 'INPUT-IDENTITY.json').read_bytes())
    assert sys.executable == config['python'] and sys.version == config['python_version']
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, {config['cpu']})
    assert os.sched_getaffinity(0) == {config['cpu']}
    roots = {k: Path(config[k]['source']) for k in ('A', 'B')}
    manifests = {k: json.loads((OUT / (k + '-source-manifest.json')).read_bytes()) for k in roots}
    rows, baseline = [], {}
    before = {k: guard(roots[k], manifests[k]) for k in roots}
    write(OUT / 'SOURCE-BEFORE.json', before)
    try:
        for number, item in enumerate(config['order']):
            family, label = item.split(':')
            directory = OUT / ('case-' + str(number).zfill(2) + '-' + family + '-' + label)
            directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
            home, temp = directory / 'home', directory / 'tmp'
            home.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            temp.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            output = directory / 'reference.worker.json'
            command = [sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B',
                       str(roots[label] / 'tools/hia_selfhost_references.py'),
                       '--family', family, '--output', str(output)]
            env = {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'HOME': str(home), 'TMPDIR': str(temp),
                   'LANG': 'C.UTF-8', 'LC_ALL': 'C.UTF-8', 'TZ': 'UTC'}
            request = {'command': command, 'cwd': str(directory), 'environment': env,
                       'affinity': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), 'source': config[label],
                       'source_guard_before': guard(roots[label], manifests[label])}
            write(directory / 'REQUEST.json', request)
            start = time.monotonic_ns()
            with (directory / 'stdout.log').open('xb') as stdout, (directory / 'stderr.log').open('xb') as stderr:
                process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=directory, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                           stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, close_fds=True)
                pid, status, usage = os.wait4(process.pid, 0)
                process.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
            end = time.monotonic_ns()
            row = {'number': number, 'family': family, 'label': label, 'pid': pid,
                   'returncode': process.returncode, 'started_monotonic_ns': start,
                   'completed_monotonic_ns': end, 'wall_elapsed_ns': end - start,
                   'user_cpu_seconds': usage.ru_utime, 'system_cpu_seconds': usage.ru_stime,
                   'cpu_seconds': usage.ru_utime + usage.ru_stime,
                   'cpu_source': 'actual direct child os.wait4 rusage; not a configured limit',
                   'rusage': {n: getattr(usage, n) for n in dir(usage) if n.startswith('ru_')},
                   'source_guard_after': guard(roots[label], manifests[label])}
            if output.exists():
                raw = output.read_bytes()
                try:
                    report = json.loads(raw)
                    payload = wire(report['reference'])
                    actual = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
                    row.update({'original_report_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                                'worker_pid_matches': report['worker_pid'] == pid,
                                'body_wall_elapsed_ns': report['wall_elapsed_ns'],
                                'reference_bytes': len(payload), 'reference_sha256': actual,
                                'reference_digest_valid': actual == report['reference_sha256'],
                                'before_B0': report['before_B0']})
                    (directory / 'reference.canonical.json').write_bytes(payload)
                    if family not in baseline:
                        baseline[family] = payload
                    row['same_complete_payload_as_first_A'] = payload == baseline[family]
                except Exception:
                    row['report_error'] = traceback.format_exc()
            else:
                row['report_missing'] = True
            row['PASS'] = (row['returncode'] == 0 and row.get('worker_pid_matches') is True
                           and row.get('reference_digest_valid') is True and row.get('before_B0') is True
                           and row.get('same_complete_payload_as_first_A') is True)
            write(directory / 'OBSERVATION.json', row)
            rows.append(row)
            with (OUT / 'PROGRESS.jsonl').open('ab') as stream:
                stream.write(wire(row) + b'\n')
            print(json.dumps({'number': number, 'family': family, 'label': label, 'PASS': row['PASS'],
                              'wall_s': row['wall_elapsed_ns'] / 1e9, 'cpu_s': row['cpu_seconds']}), flush=True)
    finally:
        after = {k: guard(roots[k], manifests[k]) for k in roots}
        write(OUT / 'SOURCE-AFTER.json', after)
        assert before == after
    result = {'schema': 'hia.cold-reference-same-host-diagnostic.v1',
              'scope': config['scope'], 'rows': rows, 'all_source_preserved': before == after,
              'status': 'PASS' if len(rows) == 8 and all(r['PASS'] for r in rows) else 'FAIL',
              'whole_native': False, 'cold_qualified': False, 'original_17_worker_qualification_replaced': False}
    write(OUT / 'RESULT.json', result)
    return 0 if result['status'] == 'PASS' else 1

def launch():
    config = json.loads((OUT / 'INPUT-IDENTITY.json').read_bytes())
    path = Path(config['A']['source']) / 'tools/hia_selfhost_process_owner.py'
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_readonly_process_owner', path)
    owner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(owner)
    home, temp = OUT / 'owner-home', OUT / 'owner-tmp'
    home.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    temp.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=False)
    env = {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'HOME': str(home), 'TMPDIR': str(temp),
           'LANG': 'C.UTF-8', 'LC_ALL': 'C.UTF-8', 'TZ': 'UTC'}
    observation = owner.run_owned(
        [sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', str(Path(__file__).resolve()), '--child'],
        cwd=OUT, env=env, stdout_path=OUT / 'owned.stdout.log', stderr_path=OUT / 'owned.stderr.log',
        receipt_path=OUT / 'process-owner.json', qualification_seconds=180, cleanup_seconds=3)
    write(OUT / 'OWNER-RETURN.json', observation)
    ok = (observation.get('status') == 'OWNED_PROCESS_COMPLETED'
          and observation.get('returncode') == 0 and observation.get('timed_out') is False
          and observation.get('cleanup', {}).get('complete') is True)
    print(json.dumps({'owner_complete': ok, 'status': observation.get('status'),
                      'returncode': observation.get('returncode'), 'timed_out': observation.get('timed_out')}))
    return 0 if ok else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--child', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raise SystemExit(child() if args.child else launch())
